title: Verify Windows utilization interface filtering and prevent duplicate binding counters
outcome: The Windows active-interface projection has documented native semantics and avoids misleading duplicate filter-layer counters where the API exposes them.
acceptance: Verify GetIfTable2 filter-layer, loopback and virtual-interface semantics against primary platform definitions before choosing a filter.
Implement or document the intended per-interface projection and add a deterministic counter fixture for the selected behavior.
Preserve valid active interfaces, explicit collection limits and the existing read-only projection; validate and independently review the final change.
